verdict.rationale: Procurement intake is a fair axis for a business-account and card-spend product, so the story applies. The evidence pack documents payments, cards, spend controls, statements and webhooks, but says nothing about procurement request forms or AI parsing of vendor contracts. Spend controls based on MCC or currency are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have vendor contracts parsed by AI to auto-populate procurement request forms
